L13·N2353unmasked layer
Largely a suppression neuron: its strongest (negative) responses come inside legalese conditional/obligation clauses of terms-of-service text ("If you object to any changes…, your only remedy is to immediately discontinue…"), especially on "If/you/object/," and the infinitival "to"; its positive side is weak and diffuse, hitting ordinary function/continuation words ("away", "to", "the", "that") in mid-sentence narrative prose.

Fires on the token immediately following a numeral — the final digit or the unit/measure word completing a numeric expression (e.g. "18‑hole", "10 hours", "109 Pcs", "15‑year", "859‑882"); the same pattern with other units drives it strongly negative, so it is a positional "post-number continuation" detector rather than a semantic one.
